name: Bow Harp
body:
Price 18,000 gp; Slot none; CL 7th; Weight 5 lbs.; Aura moderate evocation

DESCRIPTION

These small golden harps are favored by elven, fey and lillend bards. A bow harp functions as a masterwork stringed instrument and can also be used as a +2 shortbow.

If the wielder has a bardic performance or raging song ongoing, they can expend one additional round of the ability to shoot arrows made of sheer sound from the bow harp in a round. These deal the same damage of regular arrows, but all the damage dealt is sonic damage.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 9,000 gp; Feats Craft Wonderful Item; Spells desperate weapon, sound burst; Special creator must have the bardic performance class feature
